title: Thermodynamics of Learning: A Typed Four-Component Accounting of Memory, Fit, and Value
abstract: arXiv:2608.12791v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What a finite learning device has recorded and what will hold value for it on future tasks are not the same quantity. We develop a typed accounting for finite-state learning devices that separates four components: a training-side fit functional $\Phi_{\mathrm{fit}}$, the record-correlation stock $J_{D}=I(M;D)$, an update-side search ledger $\sigma_{M}$, and an operational capital value $V(M;T,b)$. This value is the work gap between an informed protocol class and a blind class obtained by deleting the memory-read port and re-optimizing from scratch. (I) Separation: for every $n$, there is a device family on which record correlation and world correlation grow by $n\ln 2$ while the capital gain is exactly zero. translated_title: 学习的热力学：记忆、拟合与价值的四分量类型化核算
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12791v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：有限学习设备所记录的内容与它在未来任务中具有价值的内容并非同一数量。我们为有限状态学习设备开发了一种类型化核算方法，将其分为四个分量：训练侧拟合泛函 $\Phi_{\mathrm{fit}}$、记录相关存量 $J_{D}=I(M;D)$、更新侧搜索账本 $\sigma_{M}$，以及操作资本价值 $V(M;T;b)$。该价值是知情协议类与通过删除记忆读取端口并从头重新优化得到的盲协议类之间的工作差距。（I）分离性：对于每个 $n$，存在一个设备族，其上记录相关性和世界相关性增长 $n\ln 2$，而资本增益恰好为零。在 $\mathrm{flat}^{*}$ 区域内，无数据更新从不增加 $V$。（II）资本化账本：一个精确的 $\mathrm{flat}^{*}$ 提取恒等式和一个通用账本恒等式，在（F5$'$）稳定的 $M$ 局部更新下给出。
tldr: 本文提出一种四分量类型化核算框架，将有限状态学习设备中的记忆、拟合与价值分离，并证明记录相关性增长可完全独立于资本价值增益。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a typed four-component accounting framework that separates memory, fit, and value in finite-state learning devices, proving that record-correlation growth can be completely decoupled from capital-value gains.
